policy_reward: sum(gamma_frame ** i * frame_reward[i] for i in range(executed_frames))

episode_units.quest_step: physics frame of first quest collection
episode_units.warmth_step: physics frame of first target warmth collection
episode_units.conditions_met_step: physics frame of first complete return conditions

replay_units.actions: one selected action per policy decision
replay_units.decisions: policy decisions and their executed frame ranges
replay_units.frames: one record per executed physics frame
replay_units.action_selected: true only on the first physical frame of a policy decision

rules: a selected action is held for action_repeat physics frames
physics, movement, pickups, interactions and contact checks still execute every 1/60 second
world timers advance once per 18 physics frames
terminate or truncate immediately without executing the remaining repeated frames
compute ProposedReward once per physical frame before aggregating the policy reward
aggregate events and raw reward terms from all executed frames
preserve raw episode returns separately from rewards returned to the learner
external max_episode_steps counts physics frames and must be a multiple of action_repeat in common training configurations
action repetition changes policy control frequency and does not guarantee a proportional wall-clock speedup
